name: locate-spoond-short-range
request: The test "reads on when spoond serves a range short" in test/spoond-rest.test.ts fails: when spoond answers a ranged file read with fewer bytes than were asked for (it caps one answer at 256 MiB), reading 7 bytes from offset 2 of a 10-byte file returns just the first few, "cde", not "cdefghi". Where's the bug?
